Background: Mr. Noel R. Wallace serves as Chief Executive Officer and Director of Colgate-Palmolive Company since April 2, 2019 and has been its President since July 11, 2018. Mr. Wallace serves as Chairman of Colgate-Palmolive Company since April 1, 2020. Mr. Wallace joined the Colgate-Palmolive Company in 1987. He served as Chief Operating Officer of Colgate-Palmolive Co., since July 11, 2018 until April 2, 2019. He is Independent Director of American Express Company since July 23, 2025. Mr. Wallace was Chief Operating Officer of Global Innovation & Growth and Hill's Pet Nutrition at Colgate-Palmolive Company since November 12, 2016 until 2018. Mr. Wallace served as Chief Operating Officer at Colgate-Palmolive Co. from September 2016 to November 11, 2016. Mr. Wallace served as the Chief Operating Officer of Global Innovation & Growth and Hill’S Pet Nutrition at Colgate-Palmolive Co. from April 1, 2016 to September 2016. Mr. Wallace served as the President of Colgate-Latin America at Colgate-Palmolive Company since 2013 until April 1, 2016. In this position, Mr. Wallace has held responsibilities in Turkey, Russia, Poland, Mexico, South Africa, Puerto Rico and Uruguay. He served as President of Colgate North America and Global Sustainability from 2010 to 2013. Mr. Wallace served as President of Colgate-Mexico and General Manager of Colgate-Mexico at Colgate-Palmolive Company since 2002. Mr. Wallace served as Vice President and General Manager for Global Toothbrush Division at Colgate-Palmolive Company. Mr. Wallace served as President of Colgate US. He First Elected as an Officer at Colgate-Palmolive Company in 2009. He began his consumer products career at Colgate-Palmolive in 1987 and has gained experience in building, growing and transforming businesses. He serves on the nonprofit board of Project Sunshine and has previously served on the boards of several nonprofits, including the American Cleaning Institute, Personal Care Product Council and American Chamber of Commerce in Poland and Mexico. He was a Director of Kellogg Company since October 01, 2015 until December 29, 2018. He served as a Member of Board of Directors of The American Cleaning Institute. He has been a member of the Board of Directors of The Consumer Goods Forum since 2019 and the Board of Trustees of New York Presbyterian Hospital since 2021. Mr. Wallace received his Bachelor of Business Administration from Texas A&M University.

Background: Mr. John Paul Bilbrey, also known as J.P. is Member of International Advisory Board of Komatsu Ltd. from March 2024. Mr. Bilbrey served as Interim CEO at Olaplex Holdings, Inc. since October 10, 2023 until December 11, 2023 and had been its Director since July 2023 as well as its Executive Chair of the Board since 2023 until July 7, 2026. He served as Executive Chair of the Board at Olaplex Holdings, Inc. since July 2023 until October 2023. He was Independent Director at Tapestry, Inc. since April 14, 2020 until November 13, 2025. Mr. Bilbrey served as an Independent Director at Elanco Animal Health Incorporated since March 13, 2019 until May 2025. Mr. Bilbrey served as an Independent Director of Campbell Soup Company since May 22, 2019. He served as the Non-Executive Chairman of The Hershey Company since April 2, 2015 until May 02, 2018. Mr. Bilbrey served as the Chief Executive Officer and President of The Hershey Company from May 17, 2011 to March 1, 2017. He also served as Chairman of Hershey from 2015 to March 2017. Mr. Bilbrey served as the Chief Operating Officer and Executive Vice President of The Hershey Company from November 2, 2010 to May 17, 2011. He served as the President of North America at The Hershey Company from December 2007 to November 2010 and served as its Senior Vice President from November 2005 to November 2010. Mr. Bilbrey has international consumer sales and marketing experience at Procter & Gamble, which included several overseas assignments. He served as the President of International Commercial group from November 2005 to December 2007 and Senior Vice President of Hershey International from 2003 to December 2007 at The Hershey Company. Mr. Bilbrey served as an Executive Vice President of Sales of Mission Foods since 2003; and served as the President, Chief Executive Officer and Executive Vice President of Retail Sales of Danone Waters of North America, Inc. a division of Groupe Danone, Paris since 2001; Owner and Operator of Commercial Cattle Operations of Bilbrey Farms and Ranch since 1999 and Director of Corporate Sales, Taiwan - Procter & Gamble Company since 1998. He served as an Independent Director of McCormick & Company, Incorporated from November 2005 to May 27, 2015. He was recently appointed as an Operating Partner at Advent International. His qualifications include: Long history of successfully building and marketing brands, buying and integrating companies and growing and leading businesses in the consumer products industry, including leadership experience at Hershey and at The Procter & Gamble Company; Expertise in overseeing financial and accounting practices, human capital management and enterprise risk management developed as Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of a global food products leader; Unique combination of livestock production, food industry and consumer insights experience, all of which are highly relevant to the industry, due to service as an owner and operator of commercial cattle operations for Bilbrey Farms and Ranch. Mr. Bilbrey has been an Independent Director at Colgate-Palmolive Company since March 13, 2015. Mr. Bilbrey joined the Colgate-Palmolive Company on March 11, 2015. He was a Director of The Hershey Company since June 2011 until May 02, 2018. He holds Bachelor of Science in Psychology from Kansas State University.

Background: Mr. John Tobin Cahill serves as Independent Director at Autodesk, Inc. since December 18, 2024. He serves as an Industrial Partner of Kleinwort Benson Advisors LLC. Mr. Cahill served as the Chief Executive Officer of Kraft Foods Group, Inc. from December 28, 2014 to July 2, 2015 and served as its Chairman from March 8, 2014 to July 2, 2015. From 2008 to 2011, he served as an Industrial Partner of at Ripplewood Holdings LLC and Ripplewood Advisors L.L.C. He was Non-Executive Chairman of Kraft Foods Group (March 2014-December 2014) and Executive Chairman of Kraft Foods Group (2012-2014). He served as Managing Director and Principal Executive Officer at Bottling Group, LLC and served as its Principal Financial Officer. At the Pepsi Bottling Group, Inc., he served as the Chief Executive Officer from September 2001 to July 2006, Executive Chairman from July 2006 to March 31, 2007 and Chairman from January 2003 to July 2006, Director of The Pepsi Bottling Group, Inc. (1999-2007). He served as the Chief Financial Officer of Pepsi-Cola North America, a subsidiary of Pepsi Bottling Group since 1996. He served as Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Kraft Foods Group, Inc. since December 2014. He previously served as Kraft Foods Group, Inc.’s non-executive Chairman from March 2014 to December 2014. He served as a Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer at Kentucky Fried Chicken since 1993, Chief Financial Officer of RKO Pictures, LLC (formerly, RKO Pictures, Inc.) and spent at PepsiCo, Inc., in a variety of roles. Mr. Cahill served as Vice President of Corporate Finance and Assistant Treasurer at PepsiCo, Inc. He was Director at Frontier Holdings, Inc. (1984-1985). He served as a Non-Executive Chairman of the Board at Kraft Foods Group, Inc. from October 1, 2012 to March 8, 2014 and as its Director from October 1, 2012 to July 2, 2015. Mr. Cahill joined Mondelez International, Inc. (“Mondelez International”), a food and beverage company and Kraft’s former parent, in January 02, 2012 as the Executive Chairman Designate, North American Grocery and served in that capacity until the spin-off of Kraft from Mondelez International in October 2012. He served as the Chairman of Old HB, Inc. He had been a Vice Chairman of The Kraft Heinz Company since July 2015 until January 01, 2026 and is its Chairman from January 01, 2026 and its Director since July 2, 2015. He has been the Lead Independent Director of American Airlines Group Inc. since December 2013. He has been an Independent Director of American Airlines, Inc. since August 1, 2015. Mr. Cahill has been an Independent Director of Colgate-Palmolive Company since October 06, 2005. Mr. Cahill joined the Colgate-Palmolive Company in October 2005. He serves as a Director of Legg Mason Canada Holdings Ltd. (2009-2014) and serves on the Boards of the U.S.- Russia Business Council, the Woodward/White Publishing Company and the Industry Affairs Council of the Grocery Manufacturers of America. He served as Director of Legg Mason Inc. from February 19, 2010 to July 29, 2014. He served as Director of Old HB, Inc. since February 2009. He served as a Director of Hostess Brands, Inc. since February 2009 and the Chairman of the National Soft Drink Association. Mr. Cahill holds an M.B.A. degree from Harvard Graduate School of Business Administration and B.A. degree in Economics from Harvard College.

Background: Dr. C. Martin Harris, M.D., M.B.A., serves as an Independent Director of Agiliti, Inc. since May 18, 2022. He serves as a Director at Agiliti Health, Inc. He has served as an Independent Director of Claritev Corporation (formerly known as MultiPlan Corporation) since January 1, 2021. Dr. Harris had been an Associate Vice President of the Health Enterprise (2016 - 2023) Interim Vice President for Medical Affairs (2021 - 2023) and Chief Business Officer at the Dell Medical School at The University of Texas at Austin since December 2016. Dr. Harris served as the Chief Information Officer and Chairman of the Information Technology Division of The Cleveland Clinic Foundation since June 1996 until November 2016. He has experience in the healthcare industry. Dr. Harris served as a Staff Physician for The Cleveland Clinic Hospital and The Cleveland Clinic Foundation Department of General Internal Medicine since June 1996 till 2016. He founded VitalStream Health, Inc. From 1991 to 1996, he served as Chief Information Officer of the University of Pennsylvania Health System. From 1990 to 1993, Dr. Harris served as an Associate Vice President of Information Systems and Technology at the University of Pennsylvania Medical Center. He serves as the Chairman of the National Health Information Infrastructure (NHII) Task Force of the Healthcare Information and Management Systems Society (HIMSS), the largest information and management systems society in the world. He serves as the Chairman of the Foundation Board for the e-Health Initiative, a public policy and advocacy group that encourages the interoperability of information technology in healthcare. He has been Chief Strategy Officer at The Cleveland Clinic Foundation from 2009 till 2016. Dr. Harris served as an Interim Chairman of Invacare Corporation from December 21, 2014 to May 14, 2015. Dr. Harris serves as a Director of Sentillion, Inc. He serves as a Member of Physician Advisory Board at OptumInsight, Inc. He had been an Independent Lead Director of Invacare Corporation since May 17, 2012 until May 19, 2022 and had been its Director since January 24, 2003 until May 19, 2022. He serves as a Director of Care Management Sciences Corporation and JobsOhio. He has been an Independent Director at Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. since March 2012 and its Member of Scientific Advisory Board since March 12, 2017. He has been an Independent Director at Colgate-Palmolive Company since March 14, 2016. Dr. Harris joined the Colgate-Palmolive Company on March 14, 2016. Dr. Harris had been an Executive Director of e-Cleveland Clinic, a series of e-health clinical programs offered over the Internet, since 2000 to 2016. He served as a Director of CareScience, Inc., since September 1997. He served as Director of MedicaLogic/Medscape Inc. since May 2000. He served as an Independent Director at Healthstream, Inc. since September 8, 2010 until February 26, 2021. From 1987 to 1996, Dr. Harris served as attending physician for the Hospital of the University of Pennsylvania and as an assistant professor of Medicine at the University Of Pennsylvania School Of Medicine where he previously served as an instructor of clinical medicine. Dr. Harris earned his B.S. and M.D. from the University of Pennsylvania, Philadelphia. His residency training in general internal medicine was completed at the Hospital of the University of Pennsylvania. He also completed a Robert Wood Johnson Clinical Scholar fellowship in General Internal Medicine at the University of Pennsylvania School of Medicine and holds a Master's in Business Administration in Healthcare Management from The Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania.

Background: Ms. Martina Therese Sophie Hund-Mejean is Director of GE Vernova Inc. from May 16, 2024. Ms. Hund-Mejean served an Independent Non-Executive Director at Royal Dutch Shell plc since May 20, 2020 until May 23, 2023. She serves as an Independent Director of Colgate-Palmolive Company since March 11, 2020. She served as Chief Financial Officer of MasterCard International Incorporated (also known as MasterCard Worldwide) since November 15, 2007 until March 31, 2019. Ms. Hund-Mejean served as Chief Financial Officer of Mastercard Incorporated since November 15, 2007. Prior to joining MasterCard in 2007, she served as Senior Vice President and Treasurer of Tyco International Ltd. from January 2003 to 2007. She joined Tyco in 2002 as part of its "new" management with responsibility for all areas of treasury, mergers, acquisitions and divestitures. Prior to Tyco, she served as Senior Vice President and Treasurer of Lucent Technologies Inc. (now Alcatel-Lucent) from November 2000 to December 2002. From 1988 to 2000, Ms. Hund-Mejean held a series of finance positions of increasing responsibility at General Motors Corporation, both in the United States and the United Kingdom, including the Assistant Treasurer post. She held positions of ascending importance at General Motors Corporation, including Assistant Treasurer, Treasurer's Office. She began her corporate career as a credit analyst at Dow Chemical in Frankfurt, Germany. Ms. Hund-Mejean serves as a Director of Covidien International Finance S.A. and Topaz International Group S.A. She has been an Independent Director of Prudential Financial, Inc. (formerly The Prudential Insurance Company of America) since October 1, 2010. She served as a Director of Tyco International Finance S.A. She served as a Director of THGSA at Covidien plc (also known as Covidien Ltd.). She served as a Director of Tyco Electronics Group S.A. She has been named one of the "100 Most Influential People in Finance" by Treasury & Risk Management Magazine on three occasions. Ms. Hund-Mejean holds a MS Degree in Economics from University of Freiburg, Germany and MS from Darden Graduate School of Business at University of Virginia.

Background: Ms. Lorrie M. Norrington is Director of Photonic Inc. from 2026. She is Director of GupShup Technology (India) Private Limited from July 2024. She was Independent Member of Board of Directors at Globoforce Limited (Workhuman) since September 16, 2020 until November 28, 2022. She has been a Member of Board of Directors at HubSpot Ventures since September 2013 & serves as its Chairman since May 8, 2025. She was Independent Director at Ancestry.com LLC since March 2021 until 2025. She previously served as an advisor to Ancestry from May 2019 to December 2020. She has been an Operating Partner and Advisor of Lead Edge Capital Management, LLC since January 2013 and serves as its Consultant. She joined the firm in 2012. Ms. Norrington has involvement with various women's networking organizations, including co-founding General Electric's Women's Network, rounds out her experience and enables her to provide insight into diversity efforts. She led a variety of businesses at General Electric Company several year period broad range of industries, including her last position as an Officer of GE and Chief Executive Officer of GE FANUC from 1999 to 2001. Previously, she served as the President and Chief Operating Officer of eBay Marketplaces at eBay Inc. from July 2008 to September 2010 and from January 2008 to July 2008 respectively. She led all eBay businesses in 39 countries. Prior to her career in Silicon Valley, she spent extensive years at General Electric in a variety of general management positions. She held various positions at eBay Inc. from 2005 to 2010. Ms. Norrington served as the President of eBay International, in Europe and Asia at Baazee.com, Inc. and eBay Inc. from July 2006 to January 2008. Prior to eBay, she served as the Chief Executive Officer and President of Shopping.com Ltd. (now eBay Marketplace Israel Ltd.) and Shopping.com, Inc. from June 1, 2005 to July 2006. She served as an Officer at Intuit, Inc., from August 2001 to January 2005, where she led the Quicken and QuickBooks brands. She served as an Executive Vice President in the Office of the Chief Executive Officer of Intuit Inc. from August 2001 to March 2005 and Executive Vice President for Small Business and Personal Finance since January 2002. She served as Lead Independent Director of HubSpot, Inc until May 8, 2025. She served as Director of Asana, Inc. since July 2019 until June 08, 2026 and served as its Lead Independent Director since August 2021 until June 08, 2026. She has been an Independent Director of Colgate-Palmolive Company since September 9, 2015 and serves as its Lead Independent Director since March 01, 2023. Ms. Norrington joined the Colgate-Palmolive Company on September 09, 2015. She had been a Director of Eventbrite, Inc. since April 2015 until August 19, 2020. Ms. Norrington had been an Independent Director of Autodesk, Inc. since March 2011 until June 18, 2025 and has been a Director at HubSpot, Inc. since September 25, 2013. She served as a Director of Duo Security, Inc until October 2019. She served as Director of BigCommerce Pty. Ltd. from March 2015 to January 2020. She served as Director at DirectTV from February 2011 to August 2015. She serves as a Member of Advisory Board at Simplificare, Inc. She serves as a Member of Executive Advisory Board at BlueData Software, Inc. and Accompani, Inc. She serves as a Board Observer of LivingSocial, LLC. She served as a Director of DIRECTV since February 10, 2011 until August 2015. She served as Member of Western Region Advisory Board at Catalyst Inc. Her previous boards include TaskRabbit and Catawiki. She served as a Director of McAfee, Inc. since December 2, 2009 until February 2011. She served as Director of Shopping.com Ltd. from November 2004 to August 2005 and Lucasfilm from June 2011 to December 2012. She obtained NACD (National Association of Corporate Directors) Fellow status in 2012. Ms. Norrington is Independent Advisor and Investor. She has expertise in growing and scaling global businesses, driving operational excellence and motivating large organizations across a broad range of industries. She has decades of leadership in key areas, including consumer technology platforms, e-commerce and innovation at a global scale. She has extensive operating experience in technology, software and internet businesses. She also has governance knowledge and experience. Ms. Norrington holds a Master in Business Administration Degree from the Harvard Business School and a Bachelor of Science Degree in Business Administration, Finance and Marketing from the University of Maryland. Ms. Norrington holds a B.A. in business administration from the University of Maryland, College Park.

Background: Dr. Christopher S. Boerner, also known as Chris, Ph.D., is Independent Director of Colgate-Palmolive Company from March 15, 2026. Dr. Boerner served as Chief Operating Officer at Bristol-Myers Squibb Company since April 26, 2023 to 2023 and served as its Executive Vice President since April 2023 to 2023 and serves as its Director since 2023 and serves as its Chief Executive Officer since November 01, 2023. He is Chairman of Bristol-Myers Squibb Company since April 01, 2024. He joined Bristol-Myers Squibb Company in 2015. He served as Executive Vice President and Chief Commercialization Officer at Bristol-Myers Squibb Company since August 28, 2018 until April 26, 2023. He was President and Head of U.S. Commercial at Bristol-Myers Squibb Company from 2015 to 2017. He was President and Head of International Markets at Bristol-Myers Squibb Company from 2017 until August 28, 2018. He served as the President and Head of the US Commercial business at Bristol-Myers Squibb (BMS). He served as an Executive Vice President of Commercial at Seattle Genetics Inc. since February 2014. He served as Senior Vice President of Commercial at Seattle Genetics Inc. from March 2012 to February 2014 and was its Executive Vice President from 2014 to 2015. He joined BMS in February 2015. He served as a Vice President of Marketing at Seattle Genetics Inc. from December 2010 to March 2012. Prior to Seattle Genetics, he was with Dendreon Corporation from June 2010 to November 2010, where he led the marketing team. He served as a Vice President of Marketing at Dendreon. From 2002 to 2010, he was with Genentech, a Member of the Roche Group, where he served in a variety of commercial roles, including Director of Marketing on Avastin, Director of Avastin franchise management and Associate Director of Oncology Market Development. Prior to Genentech, he was with McKinsey & Company, a global strategic management consulting firm, where he worked on a variety of pharmaceutical sales and marketing engagements. He was a Director of Capital Health System, Inc. since June 17, 2016. He served as a Director of Achaogen, Inc. from April 2, 2014 to June 11, 2015. He holds a Ph.D. and M.A. in Business Administration from the Haas School of Business at the University of California, Berkeley and holds an A.B. in Economics and History from Washington University in St. Louis.

Background: Ms. Lisa M. Edwards is Member of Advisory board of HTEC Group Inc. from September 2026. Ms. Edwards serves as Advisor at Smith Point Capital, LLC. Ms. Edwards joined Salesforce in 2012 as Executive Vice President, Finance, Head of Global Corporate Services and Chief Procurement Officer and has served in her current role since 2017. Prior to KnowledgeX, she served as a Manager in the strategy consulting firm Bain & Company. She serves as Director of ValuBond, Inc. Background: Ms. Kimberly A. Nelson, also known as Kim, has been Independent Director of Cummins Inc. since October 13, 2020. Ms. Nelson serves as an Independent Director of Colgate-Palmolive Company since March 11, 2021. She is Independent Non-Executive Director of Tate & Lyle PLC since July 1, 2019 and serves as its Lead Independent Non-Executive Director since January 1, 2024. She worked for General Mills Inc. for nearly 30 years prior to her retirement in January 2018. Ms. Nelson served as Senior Vice President of External Relations at General Mills, Inc. since September 2010 until 2018 and serves as its President of General Mills Foundation since June 2011. Ms. Nelson served as President of Snacks Unlimited at General Mills, Inc. from 2004 to September 2010 and served as its Senior Vice President. Ms. Nelson is responsible for the profitable growth of some of America's favorite snack brands, including: Nature Valley Granola Bars, Betty Crocker Fruit Snacks, Pop Secret popcorn and Chex Mix. She joined General Mills in 1988 and has held various positions, including director of the Revolutionizing Cereal unit, which focused on identifying growth opportunities for the cereal business. She also served as Vice President of General Mills Inc. since 1999. Ms. Nelson previously served as vice president of the Family Business Dinner unit in the Meals division of General Mills. She has been a corporate officer of General Mills since 2000. Her extensive year career spans leadership roles on a variety of brands including Hamburger Helper, Old El Paso, Cheerios, Wheaties, Yoplait, Nature Valley, Pop Secret and Chex Mix. Ms. Nelson Chair of the Minneapolis YWCA board and serves on the Congressional Black Caucus Foundation Board. She is also a member of the Executive Leadership Council, Women Corporate Directors and the National Executive Women Network and a National Association of Corporate Directors (NACD) Fellow. She was a founding member of both the Black Champions Network and the Women in Marketing Network, organizations focused on enhancing the experiences of African Americans and women within General Mills. Ms. Nelson also serves on the boards of the Northside Achievement Zone and Fair Vote Minnesota. She served as President of the Snack Food Division from 2004 to 2010. Ms. Nelson received her MBA from Columbia Business School in 1988 and a B.S. in International Relations from Georgetown University in 1984. Ms. Nelson also serves on the University of Minnesota Humphrey School of Public Affairs Advisory Council.

Background: Mr. Brian O. Newman Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of CVS Health Corporation from May 12, 2025. He serves as Independent Director of Colgate-Palmolive Company since March 15, 2024. He served as Chief Financial Officer at United Parcel Service, Inc. since 2019, until June 01, 2024 and served as its Executive Vice President until June 01, 2024. He served as Treasurer of United Parcel Service, Inc. from 2019 to 2021 and was its Senior Vice President. He was Executive Vice President of Finance & Operations - Latin America at Pepsico, Inc since September 27, 2017 until 2019 and served as its Executive Vice President of Global Operations since July 2015 until September 27, 2017.
